name: abc

name: paraphrase
title: C70 PAGES 36 TO 38, SECTION 11: ANALYSIS AND SYNTHESIS OF FRENCH
program:
-INV- ** PHASE D ANALYSE.
** C70 PAGES 36 TO 38, SECTION 11: ANALYSIS AND SYNTHESIS OF FRENCH.
** INVERTED, THE SYSTEM ANALYSES THE SENTENCE INTO ITS NORMALISED TREE.
** AS WRITTEN, IT SYNTHESISES EVERY PARAPHRASE OF THE TREE.
** THE LAST TWO PHASES PUT EACH SENTENCE ON A PATH OF ITS OWN.


** FORME ACTIVE OU PASSIVE.
PI(V(A*),I*,J*) == SUJ + I* + V(A*) + OBJ + J*.
             -- == SUJ + J* + EST + V(A*) + PPA + I*.
** NOMINALISATION D UNE PHRASE.
PH(V(A*),I*,J*) == SN(V(A*)) + DDE + J* + PPA + I*.
** FORMES DEFINITIVES DES PREPOSITIONS.
SUJ + PH(U*) == LE + FAIT + QUE + PI(U*).
OBJ + PH(U*) == QUE + PI(U*).
PPA + PH(U*) == PAR + LE + FAIT + QUE + PI(U*).
DDE + PH(U*) == DE + CE + QUE + PI(U*).
SUJ + SN(I*) == N(I*).
OBJ + SN(I*) == N(I*).
PPA + SN(I*) == PAR + N(I*).
DDE + SN(I*) == DE + N(I*).
** NOMS CONCRETS.
N(A*) == A* / A* -DANS- BEAUCEVILLE,BENOIT,GAETANE,RICHARD.
** NOMS ABSTRAITS.
N(V(DETRUIT)) == LA + DESTRUCTION.
N(V(ETONNE)) == L + ETONNEMENT.
N(V(CONSTATE)) == LA + CONSTATATION.
** VERBES.
V(A*) == A* / A* -DANS- DETRUIT,ETONNE,CONSTATE.

-REQ- ** PHASE DE SYNTHESE.

** FORME ACTIVE OU PASSIVE.
PI(V(A*),I*,J*) == SUJ + I* + V(A*) + OBJ + J*.
             -- == SUJ + J* + EST + V(A*) + PPA + I*.
** NOMINALISATION D UNE PHRASE.
PH(V(A*),I*,J*) == SN(V(A*)) + DDE + J* + PPA + I*.
** FORMES DEFINITIVES DES PREPOSITIONS.
SUJ + PH(U*) == LE + FAIT + QUE + PI(U*).
OBJ + PH(U*) == QUE + PI(U*).
PPA + PH(U*) == PAR + LE + FAIT + QUE + PI(U*).
DDE + PH(U*) == DE + CE + QUE + PI(U*).
SUJ + SN(I*) == N(I*).
OBJ + SN(I*) == N(I*).
PPA + SN(I*) == PAR + N(I*).
DDE + SN(I*) == DE + N(I*).
** NOMS CONCRETS.
N(A*) == A* / A* -DANS- BEAUCEVILLE,BENOIT,GAETANE,RICHARD.
** NOMS ABSTRAITS.
N(V(DETRUIT)) == LA + DESTRUCTION.
N(V(ETONNE)) == L + ETONNEMENT.
N(V(CONSTATE)) == LA + CONSTATATION.
** VERBES.
V(A*) == A* / A* -DANS- DETRUIT,ETONNE,CONSTATE.

-REQ- A* + .(U*) == .(A*,U*).
-REQ- .(A*,U*) == A* + .(U*).
data:
-0- RICHARD + CONSTATE + QUE + LA + DESTRUCTION + DE +
    BEAUCEVILLE + PAR + BENOIT + ETONNE + GAETANE + . -1-

name: e05-two-readings
title: QSYS-E05: AN EXPERIMENT, NOT HISTORICAL: A GRAMMAR OF OUR OWN
program:
** QSYS-E05: AN EXPERIMENT, NOT HISTORICAL: A GRAMMAR OF OUR OWN.
** AVEC LE TELESCOPE GOES WITH THE SEEING OR WITH THE MAN: BOTH READINGS
** COME OUT OF ONE ANALYSIS, AS TWO ARROWS BETWEEN THE SAME TWO VERTICES.
JEAN == SN(JEAN).
L + HOMME == SN(HOMME).
LE + TELESCOPE == SN(TELESCOPE).
AVEC + SN(I*) == SP(AVEC,I*).
SN(I*) + SP(J*,K*) == SN(I*,SP(J*,K*)).
VOIT + SN(U*) == SV(VOIT,SN(U*)).
SV(I*,J*) + SP(K*,L*) == SV(I*,J*,SP(K*,L*)).
SN(U*) + SV(W*) + . == PH(SN(U*),SV(W*)).

name: e07-shared-arrows
title: QSYS-E07: REMOVING A STRING REMOVES ITS NEIGHBOURS
program:
** QSYS-E07: REMOVING A STRING REMOVES ITS NEIGHBOURS.
** THE CUL-DE-SAC RULES OF C70 PAGES 30 AND 31 REMOVE LE FAIT QUE LE FAIT QUE,
** AND WITH IT LE FAIT QUE BENOIT, WHICH SHARES ITS FIRST THREE ARROWS.
LE + FAIT + QUE + LE + FAIT + QUE == /CUL + /DE + /SAC.
/CUL + /DE == /CULDE. /DE + /SAC == /DESAC.
data:
-0- LE + FAIT + QUE -1-
-1- LE + FAIT + QUE -2-
-1- BENOIT -2-

name: e08-parity
title: QSYS-E08, AN EXPERIMENT: THE PARITY OF THE NUMBER OF A, CARRIED FROM S
program:
** QSYS-E08, AN EXPERIMENT: THE PARITY OF THE NUMBER OF A, CARRIED FROM S.
** THERE ARE ONLY TWO RESULTS, BUT ONE APPLICATION FOR EVERY PREFIX.
S + A == O.
S + B == E.
E + A == O.
E + B == E.
O + A == E.
O + B == O.

name: e09-pair
title: QSYS-E09, AN EXPERIMENT: ONE RULE ON FOUR CHOICES OF A OR B
program:
** QSYS-E09, AN EXPERIMENT: ONE RULE ON FOUR CHOICES OF A OR B.
** A + A + A + A HAS NO A + B, BUT IT SHARES ARROWS WITH STRINGS THAT DO.
A + B == C.

name: e15-arithmetic
title: QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: NUMBERS IN UNARY AS LISTS
program:
** QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: NUMBERS IN UNARY AS LISTS.
** ADDITION AND EQUALITY ARE ONE RULE EACH.
N(U*) + PLUS + N(V*) == N(U*,V*).
N(U*) + EGAL + N(U*) == VRAI.
** MULTIPLICATION ADDS THE FIRST NUMBER ONCE FOR EACH I OF THE SECOND.
N(U*) + FOIS + N(I,V*) + ACC(W*) == N(U*) + FOIS + N(V*) + ACC(W*,U*).
N(U*) + FOIS + N + ACC(W*) == N(W*).
data:
-0- N(I,I) + PLUS + N(I,I,I) -1-
/
-0- N(I,I) + EGAL + N(I,I) -1-
/
-0- N(I,I) + EGAL + N(I) -1-
/
-0- N(I,I) + FOIS + N(I,I,I) + ACC -1-

name: e15-binary
title: QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: ADDING ONE TO A BINARY NUMBER
program:
** QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: ADDING ONE TO A BINARY NUMBER.
** THE CARRY IS A WORD Z THAT MOVES TO THE RIGHT OF INC.
B(U*,0) + INC == B(U*,1).
B(U*,1) + INC == B(U*) + INC + Z.
B + INC == B(1).
B(U*) + Z == B(U*,0).

name: e15-relations
title: QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: COMPOSING A RELATION WITH ITSELF
program:
** QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: COMPOSING A RELATION WITH ITSELF.
** ONLY FACTS NEXT TO EACH OTHER IN A STRING CAN BE JOINED.
R(A*,B*) + R(B*,C*) == R(A*,C*).

name: e15-reverse
title: QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: REVERSING A LIST INTO AN ACCUMULATOR
program:
** QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: REVERSING A LIST INTO AN ACCUMULATOR.
REV(I*,U*) + ACC(V*) == REV(U*) + ACC(I*,V*).

name: e15-rule110
title: QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: ONE STEP OF THE CELLULAR AUTOMATON RULE 110
program:
** QSYS-E15, AN EXPERIMENT: ONE STEP OF THE CELLULAR AUTOMATON RULE 110.
** THE ROW IS READ LEFT TO RIGHT, THREE CELLS AT A TIME, INTO ACC.
S(1,1,1,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(1,1,U*) + ACC(V*,0).
S(1,1,0,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(1,0,U*) + ACC(V*,1).
S(1,0,1,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(0,1,U*) + ACC(V*,1).
S(1,0,0,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(0,0,U*) + ACC(V*,0).
S(0,1,1,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(1,1,U*) + ACC(V*,1).
S(0,1,0,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(1,0,U*) + ACC(V*,1).
S(0,0,1,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(0,1,U*) + ACC(V*,1).
S(0,0,0,U*) + ACC(V*) == S(0,0,U*) + ACC(V*,0).
S(A*,B*) + ACC(V*) == ROW(V*).
